2021 DODGE DURANGO /// We know who our drivers are. They’re the ones who are
passionate about horsepower, torque and muscle. They’re also the ones who want to pull
their boat, haul the quads and take the neighbor kids skiing. That’s why our lineup
includes a seven-passenger muscle car. Dodge Durango handles all of life’s demands
while also satisfying our drivers’ demand for intense performance.
NEW LOOK, BIGGER ATTITUDE /// Our drivers love this vehicle’s bold stance and
attitude. We’d never change that, but we evolved it with a new front fascia, LED projector
headlamps and rear spoiler. SUVs don’t usually get a lot of attention for their spoiler,
but this is a Dodge. When your powertrain lineup is as stacked as ours, it’s necessary.
It only makes sense: if Durango looks and performs like a muscle car, shouldn’t the
interior feel like a muscle car? So, we refreshed the inside with sporty design cues and
even more technology.
